title: Gold futures rise to ₹1.54 lakh/10 gm on spot demand - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Globally, gold futures increased 0.35 per cent to $4,406.15 per ounce in New York. | Photo Credit: iStockphoto

Gold prices on Tuesday rose by ₹1,501 to ₹1.54 lakh per 10 grams in futures trade as speculators created fresh positions on a firm spot demand.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the yellow metal contracts for October delivery traded higher by ₹1,501, or 0.98 per cent, at ₹1,54,600 per 10 grams in a business turnover of 1,332 lots.

Fresh positions built up by participants led to a rise in precious metal prices, analysts said.

Globally, gold futures increased 0.35 per cent to $4,406.15 per ounce in New York.
